description: Source code implementing DataRobot-specific configuration for OpenAI chat completions, including URL resolution and API key management.

classes.name: DataRobotConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for DataRobot's OpenAI chat API integration, handling API URL and key resolution.

methods.name: _resolve_api_key
methods.description: Resolves the API key, preferring user input or secret manager, defaults to fake key for testing.

methods.name: _resolve_api_base
methods.description: Resolves the API base URL, appending necessary paths based on the input or defaults.

methods.name: _get_openai_compatible_provider_info
methods.description: Returns the API base and key, resolving from user input or secret manager.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Returns the complete API URL for chat completions, based on the API base.
